symptoms.label: Initial emergency-department GCS score of 12 or less
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: GCS score below 15 at two hours after the injury
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: Suspected open or depressed skull fracture
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: Sign of basal skull fracture
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: Post-traumatic seizure
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: Focal neurological deficit
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: More than one episode of vomiting
symptoms.description: Adult head-injury criterion from NICE NG232 recommendation 1.5.8.

symptoms.label: Negative chest eFAST result
symptoms.description: A documented negative chest eFAST does not exclude pneumothorax.

symptoms.label: Negative FAST result
symptoms.description: A documented negative FAST does not exclude intraperitoneal or retroperitoneal haemorrhage.

symptoms.label: Suspected knee fracture in a person over 2
symptoms.description: A documented suspected knee fracture in a person over 2, for review using the cited clinical decision rule.

symptoms.label: Reduction or cast, splint, or traction application
symptoms.description: A documented reduction of a fracture or dislocation, or application of a cast, splint, or traction, requiring neurovascular documentation.

symptoms.label: Documented pregnancy
symptoms.description: Pregnancy documented by the clinical team; pregnancy alone does not prohibit necessary imaging.

symptoms.label: Documented anticoagulant treatment
symptoms.description: Anticoagulant treatment documented by the clinical team; medication status is not inferred from symptoms.

symptoms.label: Documented or suspected opioid intoxication
symptoms.description: Opioid intoxication documented or suspected by the clinical team; it is not inferred from a symptom alone.

symptoms.label: Documented anaesthesia allergy
symptoms.description: Anaesthesia allergy status documented by the clinical team. ABSENT represents a documented absence; UNKNOWN represents an unresolved status.
